title: Lapy JB Daemon v1.2: standalone jailbreak service for homebrew apps
summary: Lapy JB Daemon gives homebrew apps jailbreak-on-demand access without relying on etaHEN, supporting firmware 3.00 through 12.00.
body: Lapy JB Daemon by ArkSama is a standalone PS5 daemon that replaces etaHEN's jailbreak-on-demand function. When a homebrew app needs elevated access, it writes a request file and the daemon handles it automatically. Version 1.2 added multi-firmware support covering firmware 3.00 to 12.00, up from the original v1.0 which only supported 9.40.

It runs without etaHEN — just kstuff and a homebrew launcher. Launch it from HBL or add it to your autoload.txt to start it at boot. It logs activity to klog for debugging. Built on libhijacker and ps5-payload-sdk, it's a lightweight alternative for apps that need jailbreak privileges.

title: LegacyJB: jailbreak service on port 9028 for homebrew apps
summary: LegacyJB opens a TCP jailbreak service on port 9028, providing jailbreak access to supported homebrew apps like Homebrew Store and Itemzflow.
body: LegacyJB by Phoenixx1202 is a PS5 payload that runs a jailbreak service on TCP port 9028. Like Lapy JB Daemon, it monitors file-based requests from supported applications and provides elevated access when needed. It's built for compatibility with Homebrew Store and Itemzflow.

It logs its activity to /user/data/legacy_jb.log with automatic log rotation. Built and tested with PS5 Payload SDK v0.43. It's a developer-focused tool — no GitHub releases are published, so grab the latest from the repository source.

title: PS5 Upload: the full-featured package manager for jailbroken PS5
summary: PS5 Upload transfers games, apps and homebrew from your computer to your PS5 with resume support, archive extraction, NAS browsing and a web interface.
body: PS5 Upload by PhantomPtr is a desktop and web tool for moving games, apps and homebrew to a jailbroken PS5. It uses a custom binary protocol with BLAKE3 verification, supports resume after disconnects, and can extract .zip, .7z and .rar archives on the fly during transfer. It also mounts .exfat and .ffpkg images, browses and manages files on the console, sends payloads (.elf, .bin, .js, .lua, .jar), and handles PKG installs. NAS and SMB share support is built in.

Available on Windows 10+, macOS 11+, Linux (Ubuntu 24.04+), and Android. The web interface lets you manage the PS5 from any browser on your LAN, or run it in Docker. It supports firmware 1.00 to 13.60 and includes hardware info, screenshot browsing, and 18 UI languages. The payload targets the ps5-payload-dev SDK v0.42.

title: ShadowPKG: self-hosted PKG library manager for PS5
summary: ShadowPKG is a self-hosted web app that lets you browse, search and send .pkg files to a jailbroken PS5 from any device on your network.
body: ShadowPKG by NotSoTypicalGamer is a self-hosted Node.js web package manager for jailbroken PS5 and PS4. It reads title, content ID, version and type from each PKG file, groups games with their updates and DLC, and flags duplicates. You can browse, search, rename, delete, and send packages to one or more saved consoles with queue management.

It runs as just server.js and index.html on Node.js 18+ or Docker. It supports HTTP range downloads so consoles can resume, reads packages inside uncompressed .rar archives without extracting, and handles FTP-connected consoles. Requires a DPI v2 payload (Elf Arsenal or etaHEN) on the PS5. Features themes, cover art, a live activity log, and a setup panel.

title: RetroArch for PS5: multi-system emulation with five cores
summary: A native RetroArch port running on PS5 with Vulkan output and cores for NES, SNES, GBA, Mega Drive and arcade systems.
body: PS5 RetroArch by mihawk-99 is a native port of RetroArch that renders through PS5's Vulkan GPU driver. It ships with five emulator cores: FCEUmm (NES/Famicom), mGBA (Game Boy, GBC, GBA), Snes9x (SNES), FinalBurn Neo (arcade including Neo Geo and Sega System 16/32), and Genesis Plus GX (Mega Drive, Master System, Game Gear, SG-1000, Sega CD). The default menu is XMB with RGUI as an alternative.

It supports controller remapping, analog stick navigation, stereo PCM audio, and configuration save/load. An active development project — save state persistence, networking, shaders, and 4K/VRR/HDR are not yet validated. Copy the PPSA99169 folder to /data/homebrew/ on your jailbroken PS5. Supply your own ROMs and BIOS files. Based on RetroArch 1.22.2.

title: mupen64plus for PS5: dedicated Nintendo 64 emulation
summary: A standalone N64 emulator for PS5 based on mupen64plus, offering dedicated N64 emulation outside of RetroArch.
body: mupen64plus for PS5 by TheRealRetro brings dedicated Nintendo 64 emulation to the console as a native homebrew app. Based on the mupen64plus emulator, it focuses specifically on N64 compatibility rather than being a multi-system solution like RetroArch.

Install it as a homebrew app through your loader. Supply your own N64 ROMs. For a more integrated multi-system approach, RetroArch also includes N64 support, but this standalone build may offer better compatibility or performance for specific titles.

title: SilverBirch: Nintendo DS emulation on PS5 via melonDS
summary: SilverBirch brings melonDS-based Nintendo DS emulation to PS5 as a native homebrew app.
body: SilverBirch by BaZZtian is a Nintendo DS emulator for PS5 based on melonDS. It emulates both screens of the DS, with the PS5's display handling the dual-screen layout. DS games with touch controls use the controller's analog sticks or touchpad for input.

Install it as a homebrew app and supply your own DS ROMs and optionally the DS BIOS files. The melonDS core is known for strong compatibility with the DS library. This is one of the more niche emulators in the PS5 homebrew scene, filling the gap for anyone who wants to revisit their DS library on the big screen.

title: PSXS5: PS1 emulation on PS5 through PCSX-ReARMed
summary: PSXS5 is a PS1 emulator for PS5 based on PCSX-ReARMed, offering original PlayStation game compatibility.
body: PSXS5 by SynoPiia brings PS1 emulation to the PS5 through a native port of PCSX-ReARMed. It's one of two PS1 emulator options for the console, alongside SwanStation. PCSX-ReARMed is known for its broad compatibility across the PS1 library.

Supply your own PS1 disc images (BIN/CUE or ISO) and the PS1 BIOS. Install as a homebrew app through your loader. Also available through ProsperoStore for easy installation. For an alternative PS1 emulator experience, SwanStationPS5 uses a different codebase.

title: Stremio for PS5: unofficial streaming client
summary: An unofficial native Stremio port for PS5 that brings the add-on-based streaming platform to the console.
body: Stremio for PS5 by Sp9nky is an unofficial native port of the Stremio streaming platform. Stremio uses community add-ons to aggregate content from various streaming sources, and this port brings that to the PS5 as a homebrew app.

Install as a homebrew app and sign in with your Stremio account to sync your add-ons and library. Also available through ProsperoStore. For an alternative Stremio experience, StremiBrew and Stremio Plus offer different implementations of the same platform.

title: StremiBrew: another native Stremio port for PS5
summary: StremiBrew is an independent native Stremio client for PS5, offering an alternative to Sp9nky's port.
body: StremiBrew by stupiditytries is another native Stremio client for jailbroken PS5. Like the Sp9nky port, it brings the add-on-based streaming platform to the console, but with its own implementation and potentially different feature support.

Install through ProsperoStore or manually as a homebrew app. Sign in with your Stremio account to access your library and add-ons. The PS5 homebrew scene now has three Stremio options: this one, Sp9nky's port, and Stremio Plus by LoZazaMastro.

title: Emby5: native Emby media server client for PS5
summary: Emby5 is a native Emby client for jailbroken PS5, connecting to your Emby media server.
body: Emby5 by bornaradusin is a native Emby client for PS5. If you run an Emby media server at home, this homebrew app connects to it and lets you browse and play your media library directly on the console without needing the web browser.

Install as a homebrew app or through ProsperoStore. Point it at your Emby server's address on your local network. For Jellyfin users (the open-source Emby fork), Jelly5 and Mortalfin are the alternatives.

title: VLC for PS5: the iconic media player comes to homebrew

Install through ProsperoStore or manually as a homebrew app. Drop media files onto a USB drive or access network shares. VLC's codec library means you won't need to worry about format compatibility — it plays what the PS5's built-in player won't.

title: Sonic Unleashed Recompiled: the Xbox 360 classic runs natively on PS5
summary: A static recompilation of Sonic Unleashed from Xbox 360, running natively on PS5 with Vulkan rendering at up to 4K.
body: Sonic Unleashed Recompiled by Nazky is a PS5 port of the Xbox 360 Sonic Unleashed, using static recompilation to convert the game's code and shaders for native execution. It renders through Vulkan at up to 4K (3840x2160), with DualSense support including touchpad navigation on the World Map. Auto-detects language from PS5 system settings, with in-game language and voice switching.

You must supply your own legally obtained Xbox 360 copy of Sonic Unleashed (US or EU retail plus the Title Update). Built from the community hedge-dev UnleashedRecomp project. Known issues include occasional frame drops in heavy scenes and minor input lag. Build requires Linux with clang/lld 18+.

summary: ScreenTester5 displays test patterns on your PS5 to check for dead pixels, colour accuracy and screen uniformity.

title: RommPS: sync saves with a RomM server from PS5
summary: RommPS connects your PS5 to a RomM server to sync save data across devices.

title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows ported to PS5

Install through ProsperoStore. Insert an audio CD and play. A simple utility that fills a gap Sony left — the PS5 plays Blu-ray and DVD movies but not CDs out of the box.

title: SwanStationPS5: alternative PS1 emulator for PS5

title: DriftCheck: controller stick drift tester for PS5

title: ProsperoLight: Moonlight game streaming on PS5
summary: An unofficial Moonlight port for PS5, streaming games from your PC with an NVIDIA GPU to the console.

Install through ProsperoStore. Your PC needs NVIDIA GeForce Experience / GameStream or Sunshine running. Connect both devices to the same network for best results. An alternative to Sony's own Remote Play for streaming from your own PC.

summary: A prototype GeForce NOW cloud gaming client for PS5, in early experimental stages.
body: OpenNOW PS5 by Portablelle is an experimental GeForce NOW client for PS5. It aims to bring NVIDIA's cloud gaming service to the console, letting you stream your PC game library from NVIDIA's servers.
Install through ProsperoStore. This is a prototype and may not fully work yet. Cloud gaming on PS5 is a growing area, with PSBox (Xbox Cloud) and Playden (Steam) also available.

title: Prospero Explorer: file manager for PS5
summary: Prospero Explorer is a file manager and archive tool for PS5, browsing the console's filesystem.
body: Prospero Explorer by SvenGDK is a file manager for PS5 that lets you browse the console's filesystem, manage files, and handle archives. Copy, move, delete and extract files directly on the console.
Install through ProsperoStore. Part of SvenGDK's Prospero utility suite, alongside Prospero Multi Tools and Prospero Vibrate. A fundamental utility for anyone managing homebrew files.

title: Prospero Multi Tools: backup manager for retro formats
summary: A multi-format backup manager for PS5, handling retro game formats and disc images.
body: Prospero Multi Tools by SvenGDK is a backup manager for PS5 that handles various retro game and disc image formats. It organises, manages, and prepares files for use with emulators and other homebrew apps.
Install through ProsperoStore. Part of SvenGDK's Prospero utility suite. Useful for organising your retro game library across the various emulators available on PS5.

title: Mortalfin: Jellyfin client in beta for PS5
summary: Mortalfin is a native Jellyfin client for PS5 in beta, offering another option alongside Jelly5.
body: Mortalfin by mortaljinx is a native Jellyfin client for PS5 currently in beta. It's the second dedicated Jellyfin client for the console, alongside Jelly5, giving Jellyfin users another option.
Install through ProsperoStore. Point it at your Jellyfin server URL. Being in beta, some features may be incomplete. If stability is your priority, Jelly5 is the more established alternative.

title: PS5VR: VR video player for PS VR2
summary: PS5VR plays VR video content through the PS VR2 headset on a jailbroken PS5.
body: PS5VR by theghostonline is a VR video player for PS5 that outputs to the PS VR2 headset. Watch 360-degree and VR video content through the headset as a native homebrew app.
Install through ProsperoStore. Supply your own VR video files. Requires a PS VR2 headset connected to the PS5. One of the few homebrew apps that takes advantage of PS VR2 hardware.

title: PSSwanStation: yet another PS1 emulator for PS5
summary: PSSwanStation is a third PS1 emulator option for PS5, also based on the SwanStation core.
body: PSSwanStation by Press5elect is another PS1 emulator for PS5 based on the SwanStation core. The PS5 now has three PS1 emulator options: PSXS5 (PCSX-ReARMed), SwanStationPS5 (darkxex), and this one.
Install through ProsperoStore. Supply your own PS1 disc images and BIOS. Different builds can have different compatibility and performance, so try each to see which works best for your games.

title: Nuvio Max'd: unofficial Nuvio TV client for PS5
summary: An unofficial Nuvio client for PS5 with enhanced features.
body: Nuvio Max'd by HandshakeHackin is an unofficial Nuvio TV client for PS5 with extra features beyond the basic client. Nuvio is an IPTV service, and this enhanced version aims to provide a better viewing experience.
Install through ProsperoStore. Requires a Nuvio subscription. An alternative to the standard Nuvio PS5 client by bilawalriaz, with the 'Max'd' version offering additional features.

title: Ship of Harkinian (Vulkan): OoT with Vulkan rendering on PS5
summary: A Vulkan-powered build of Ship of Harkinian (Ocarina of Time) for PS5, separate from the standard port.
body: Ship of Harkinian (Vulkan) by damiantw is an alternative build of the Ocarina of Time PC port for PS5, rendering through Vulkan instead of the standard graphics backend. It may offer different performance or visual characteristics.
Supply your own Ocarina of Time ROM to generate the assets. Install through ProsperoStore. For the standard Ship of Harkinian build, mshivam019's version is the other option.

sources.name: Ship of Harkinian Vulkan on GitHub

title: Steam Remote Play: stream Steam games to PS5
summary: An unofficial Steam Remote Play (Steam Link) client for PS5, streaming your Steam library to the console.
body: Steam Remote Play for PS5 by jmelovich is an unofficial Steam Link client that streams games from your PC's Steam library to the PS5. It uses Valve's Remote Play protocol for low-latency game streaming.

Install through ProsperoStore. Your PC needs Steam running with Remote Play enabled. Connect both devices to the same network. An alternative to Playden for streaming Steam games — Remote Play streams the video, while Playden runs the games locally through Wine.

sources.name: Steam Remote Play PS5 on GitHub

title: PS5MC: Kodi 22 media center on PS5
summary: A native Kodi 22 port for PS5, turning the console into a full media center.
body: PS5MC by VivaLaVent ports Kodi 22 to the PS5, turning the console into a full-featured media center. Kodi is the go-to open-source media center with support for add-ons, libraries, and virtually every media format.

Install through ProsperoStore. Configure your media sources, add-ons, and library. If you've used Kodi on any other platform, you know what to expect. The most comprehensive media center option on PS5.

title: Twispero: Twitch client for PS5
summary: A native Twitch client for PS5, watching live streams on the console.
body: Twispero by unicxrn is a native Twitch client for PS5. Watch live streams, browse channels, and follow your favourite streamers directly on the console without needing the web browser.
Install through ProsperoStore. Sign in with your Twitch account or browse anonymously. A dedicated app experience rather than using Twitch through the console's web browser.

title: GyroAim: add gyro aiming to any PS5 game
summary: GyroAim adds DualSense gyroscope aiming to any game on a jailbroken PS5.
body: GyroAim by jmelovich adds gyroscope-based aiming to any game on a jailbroken PS5. It intercepts controller input and translates DualSense motion data into aim movement, giving you Splatoon-style gyro aiming in games that don't natively support it.
Install through ProsperoStore. Configure sensitivity and dead zones to your preference. A game-changer for FPS games that don't offer built-in gyro aiming.

title: Régie5: media stack remote control for PS5
summary: Régie5 is a remote control app for managing media playback and sources on PS5.
body: Régie5 by viviandsx is a media stack remote control for PS5. It helps you manage and switch between different media apps and sources from a single interface.
Install through ProsperoStore. A utility for users running multiple media apps (VLC, Kodi, Jellyfin, etc.) who want a unified control point.

title: PS5LM Plus: run GGUF language models on PS5
summary: PS5LM Plus runs local GGUF-format language models on PS5 for offline AI chat.
body: PS5LM Plus by abhi245y runs local GGUF-format language models on the PS5. It loads quantised models and runs inference entirely on the console — no internet needed. Similar to ProsperoAI but using the GGUF model format.
Install through ProsperoStore. Supply your own .gguf model files. Performance depends on model size — smaller quantised models will run more smoothly. A tech showcase of local AI on console hardware.

title: Cloud Play: Chiaki-based game streaming for PS5
summary: Cloud Play is a Chiaki-based cloud game streaming client for PS5.
body: Cloud Play by tertiumndatur is a game streaming client for PS5 built on the Chiaki framework. Chiaki is an open-source implementation of Sony's Remote Play protocol, and this app repurposes it for cloud-based game streaming.

Install through ProsperoStore. Configure your streaming source and connect. Adds to the PS5's growing cloud gaming options alongside PSBox (Xbox Cloud), ProsperoLight (Moonlight/GeForce), and Steam Remote Play.

title: Morrowind on PS5: OpenMW port
summary: An OpenMW port that runs The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind natively on PS5.
body: Morrowind for PS5 by mshivam019 ports the OpenMW engine to the console, letting you play The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind as a native homebrew title. OpenMW is the open-source engine reimplementation known for bug fixes and mod support.
Supply your own Morrowind game data (from your Steam or GOG copy). Install through ProsperoStore. One of the larger RPG ports available on PS5 homebrew, joining the Zelda and Mario titles.

title: DOOM Native Port: the original DOOM on PS5
summary: A native source port of the original 1993 DOOM for PS5.
body: DOOM Native Port by lowbit is a source port of the original 1993 DOOM for PS5. It runs the classic id Software shooter natively on the console — the shareware WAD or your own DOOM/DOOM II WAD files.
Install through ProsperoStore. Supply your own WAD files for the full game. With this, Quake, Quake II, Quake III, and Doom 3, the full classic id Software catalogue now runs on PS5 homebrew.

title: OpenRCT2: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 on PS5
summary: A port of OpenRCT2 for PS5, running the RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 engine natively.
body: OpenRCT2 for PS5 by lowbit ports the open-source RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 engine to the console. Build and manage your own theme park with the classic RCT2 gameplay, now on the big screen.

Supply your own RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 game data. Install through ProsperoStore. OpenRCT2 adds multiplayer, UI improvements, and new features to the original game. Controller navigation handles the mouse-driven interface.

title: PShare: send media to multiple destinations from PS5
summary: PShare sends media files from the PS5 to multiple destinations at once.
body: PShare by StonedModder is a media sharing tool for PS5 that sends files to multiple destinations simultaneously. It handles screenshots, video clips, and other media from the console.
Install through ProsperoStore. Configure your destinations and share media without needing to transfer files one at a time to individual devices.

title: PICO-8 for PS5: fantasy console on the big screen
summary: A loader for PICO-8 on PS5, running the fantasy console's vast game library.
body: PICO-8 for PS5 by RafaelNGP loads and runs the PICO-8 fantasy console on PS5. PICO-8 has thousands of small games made by indie developers — puzzle games, platformers, RPGs, demoscene experiments.
Install through ProsperoStore. You need your own PICO-8 build (a licensed copy from Lexaloffle). Load .p8 cartridge files and play. A great way to explore the massive PICO-8 game library on your TV.

title: Prospero Vibrate: DualSense vibration studio
summary: A vibration and haptic testing tool for the DualSense controller on PS5.
body: Prospero Vibrate by SvenGDK is a DualSense vibration and haptic testing studio for PS5. Test different vibration patterns, intensity levels, and haptic feedback on your controller.
Install through ProsperoStore. Part of SvenGDK's Prospero utility suite. Useful for developers testing haptic feedback and for users checking their controller's vibration motors.

title: Forwarder Manager: home screen emulator launchers for PS5
summary: Creates home screen shortcuts that launch specific games in emulators, like having each ROM as its own app.
body: Forwarder Manager by heydemoura creates home screen launcher shortcuts for emulated games on PS5. Instead of opening an emulator and browsing for a ROM, each game gets its own icon on the home screen that launches directly into it.

Install through ProsperoStore. Select an emulator and a ROM, and it creates a home screen shortcut. A quality-of-life tool that makes the PS5 feel like a retro game console with each game as a first-class app.

title: Nuvio PS5: standard Nuvio TV client
summary: A native Nuvio IPTV client for PS5 by bilawalriaz.
body: Nuvio PS5 by bilawalriaz is a native Nuvio TV client for jailbroken PS5. Nuvio is an IPTV service, and this app provides the standard client experience on the console.
Install through ProsperoStore. Requires a Nuvio subscription. For an enhanced version with extra features, Nuvio Max'd by HandshakeHackin is the alternative.

title: PokeMMO Prospero: alternative PokeMMO client for PS5
summary: A second PokeMMO client build for PS5, running through the Linux compatibility layer.
body: PokeMMO Prospero by Shabbypenguin is another PokeMMO client for PS5, running the Linux version of the Pokémon MMO. It's a separate build from bizkut's ps5-pokemmo, offering a different approach to getting PokeMMO running on the console.
Install through ProsperoStore. You need the game's ROM files from your own Pokémon cartridges. For the other PokeMMO option that runs through Wine, see the bizkut build.

title: etaHEN: the homebrew enabler that started it all
summary: etaHEN is the primary homebrew enabler for jailbroken PS5. It unlocks JIT, debug settings and the ability to run unsigned code.
body: etaHEN is the go-to homebrew enabler that most PS5 homebrew apps depend on. Once loaded, it patches the kernel to allow unsigned ELF payloads, enables JIT compilation that emulators need, and adds debug settings to the console's menus. Most homebrew READMEs list etaHEN as a requirement.

It runs as a payload through your exploit chain. After a reboot you need to re-run it, since all current PS5 exploits are tethered. etaHEN maintains a jailbreak list that controls which apps get elevated privileges, and several newer tools like Lapy JB Daemon offer alternative ways to grant that access.
Latest release: etaHEN 2.5B (December 25, 2025) — adds the option to choose your cheats repo and an unpause kstuff toggle.

title: OnionHEN: an alternative homebrew enabler
summary: OnionHEN offers the same unsigned-code privileges as etaHEN with a different codebase.
body: OnionHEN is another homebrew enabler for jailbroken PS5. Like etaHEN, it patches the kernel so you can run unsigned ELF payloads and homebrew apps. It's maintained by aydencharles as an independent project.

It's a drop-in alternative to etaHEN. Load it as a payload through your exploit chain. Some homebrew apps specifically check for etaHEN, so compatibility may vary. Check the README for supported firmware versions.

title: kstuff: the kernel patch payload that most homebrew needs
summary: kstuff patches the PS5 kernel for homebrew compatibility. Nearly every emulator and advanced tool lists it as a requirement.
body: kstuff by EchoStretch is a kernel patch payload that most PS5 homebrew depends on. It patches the running kernel to allow features that emulators, file managers and ports need to function. If a homebrew app's README says it needs kstuff, this is the one.

Load it as a payload after your exploit chain runs. There's also kstuff lite, a lighter version with a smaller footprint, and a fork by drakmor. Note that kstuff 1.13 DR test6, a development build by drakmor, is only shared through X posts and forum downloads, not on GitHub.
Latest release: kstuff v1.6.7 (January 4, 2026) — supports firmware 3.00 through 10.01.

title: kstuff lite: a lightweight kernel patcher
summary: A smaller version of kstuff with a lighter footprint. Available in the original and a drakmor fork.
body: kstuff lite strips down the full kstuff payload to the essentials. It patches the kernel for homebrew compatibility without the overhead of the full version. Some apps like Playden specifically ask for kstuff lite rather than the full version.
There are two versions: EchoStretch's original and drakmor's fork. Both work the same way, loaded as a payload after your exploit chain. The drakmor fork may include additional patches or fixes.
Latest release: kstuff lite v1.11 (September 20, 2026) — beta supporting firmware 1.00 through 13.60.

title: Y2JB: jailbreak entry point through the YouTube app
summary: Y2JB uses the PlayStation's YouTube app as a WebKit entry point to trigger the exploit chain.
body: Y2JB by Gezine turns the YouTube app on PS5 into a jailbreak entry point. It exploits a WebKit vulnerability in the app's embedded browser to gain initial code execution, which then loads the kernel exploit.

It's the base that the Y2JB Autoloader builds on. The Autoloader adds automatic payload loading and Relapse integration, making the process one-tap. If you're using the Autoloader, you don't need to run Y2JB separately.
Latest release: Y2JB 1.6 (June 9, 2026) — adds firmware 12.60+ support.

title: WebKit Autoloader: jailbreak through the PS5 browser
summary: An autoloader that uses the PS5's built-in web browser as the entry point instead of YouTube.
body: The WebKit Autoloader by itsPLK is the browser-based counterpart to the Y2JB Autoloader. Instead of going through YouTube, it uses the PS5's built-in web browser to trigger the WebKit exploit and load your payloads.

It works with the same autoload.txt system as the Y2JB version. Configure your payloads once and they load automatically each time you visit the exploit page. It's an option for consoles where the YouTube app method doesn't work or you prefer the browser route.
Latest release: WebKit Autoloader v0.6.1 (October 8, 2026) — fixes Poops support for firmware 9.05, 11.40, and 11.60.

title: Remote Lua Loader: run Lua scripts on your PS5 from a browser
summary: A payload that opens a Lua scripting interface accessible from any browser on your network.
body: Remote Lua Loader by shahrilnet starts a web server on the PS5 that accepts Lua scripts from your browser. It's useful for testing, development and quick one-off tasks without building a full ELF payload.

Load it as a payload after jailbreaking, then open the IP address in a browser on the same network. Type or paste a Lua script and it executes on the console. It's aimed at developers and tinkerers rather than everyday use.

title: elfldr: the ELF loader that homebrew apps connect to
summary: A payload that listens on port 9021 and loads ELF binaries sent to it. Many homebrew tools expect it to be running.
body: elfldr from ps5-payload-dev is a standard ELF loader that listens on TCP port 9021. When a tool like PS5 Upload or ShadowMountPlus wants to launch a homebrew app, it sends the ELF binary to this port. ProsperoStore, RecompStore and many other homebrew apps list it as a requirement.
It's part of the ps5-payload-dev SDK ecosystem. Load it as a payload after jailbreaking and it stays resident in the background. It's one of the foundational pieces of the PS5 homebrew stack.
Latest release: elfldr v0.26 (August 29, 2026) — simplified makefile.

title: ppr-patch: A53 PPR patcher by drakmor
summary: A kernel-level patcher targeting the PS5's A53 PPR subsystem. A developer-focused tool.
body: ppr-patch by drakmor is a specialised kernel patcher that targets the PS5's ARM A53 PPR (PlayStation Platform Runtime) subsystem. It's a developer tool rather than something end users need to run directly.
It doesn't publish GitHub releases, so check the repository page for the latest code. It's part of drakmor's broader work on PS5 kernel tooling, alongside nanoDNS and the kstuff lite fork.

title: nanoDNS: a DNS proxy payload for jailbroken PS5
summary: A lightweight DNS proxy that runs as a payload, letting you redirect network requests on the console.
body: nanoDNS by drakmor is a DNS proxy that runs directly on the PS5 as a payload. It intercepts DNS queries from the console, which can be used to redirect traffic, block update servers, or route requests to a local host page.
It's useful for keeping a jailbroken console from accidentally checking for firmware updates. Like ppr-patch, it doesn't publish GitHub releases. Check the repo for the latest code.

title: Payload Manager: a web dashboard for your PS5 payloads
summary: A browser-based dashboard for importing, organising and auto-loading payloads on a jailbroken PS5.
body: Payload Manager by itsPLK gives you a web-based dashboard for managing payloads on your PS5. Open its IP address in a browser and you can import ELF payloads, organise them, and set an autoload order that runs every time you jailbreak.

It pairs with the Y2JB Autoloader: when no autoload.txt is configured, the Autoloader opens Payload Manager by default so you can pick what to load. It also supports drag-and-drop importing and one-tap loading from the browser.

title: ShadowMountPlus: auto-mount game dumps without a reboot
summary: Automatically registers homebrew apps and game dumps on the PS5 home screen. Nearly every homebrew tool depends on it.
body: ShadowMountPlus by drakmor is the glue that makes homebrew apps appear on your PS5's home screen. It monitors the /data/homebrew directory and automatically mounts anything it finds as a native title, complete with icons.

Almost every homebrew app lists ShadowMountPlus as a requirement. Version 1.7 beta 5 is the minimum for newer tools like Playden and RecompStore. It needs kstuff and an ELF loader on port 9021 to function.
Latest release: ShadowMountPlus 1.7-beta5fix1 (October 10, 2026) — adds per-game fakelib modes and removes legacy kstuff auto-pause.

title: PS5-Suite: file transfer and console management
summary: A suite of tools for transferring files and managing a jailbroken PS5 from a computer.
body: PS5-Suite by manos555555 bundles file transfer and console management tools into one package. It handles sending files to and from the console over your network, with a focus on keeping things simple.
It's an alternative to PS5 Upload for users who want a lighter tool. Check the GitHub page for supported firmware versions and setup instructions.

title: PS5 Game Compressor: shrink and move game dumps
summary: Compresses PS5 game dumps to save storage space and transfers them between internal and external drives.
body: PS5 Game Compressor by juma-sayeh shrinks game dumps so they take less space on your drive. It can also move compressed dumps between internal and external storage.
Useful when you're running low on space with multiple homebrew apps and game backups installed. It works alongside ShadowMountPlus to keep your games accessible after compression.
Latest release: PS5 Game Compressor v1.0.4 (August 21, 2026) — adds multilingual UI.

title: MacheteSVG: PS5 save manager
summary: A save manager that lets you back up, restore and manage PS5 game saves on a jailbroken console.
body: MacheteSVG by VenezuelanBiggie24 is a save manager for jailbroken PS5. It can back up your game saves, restore them, and manage saves across different accounts or games.
Save management is important on a jailbroken console since you can't rely on PS Plus cloud saves while staying offline. MacheteSVG gives you local control over your save data.

title: Itemzflow: game launcher and homebrew manager
summary: A visual game launcher that manages your installed games and homebrew apps with cover art and organisation features.
body: Itemzflow by LightningMods is a game launcher and manager for jailbroken PS5. It gives you a visual interface for browsing and launching your installed games and homebrew, with cover art, sorting and filtering.

It's one of the more established PS5 homebrew tools, offering features like app installation, a built-in FTP client and background music. It needs a jailbreak service like etaHEN or LegacyJB for full functionality.
Latest release: Itemzflow 1.08 (May 31, 2026) — adds Fuse support for firmware 12.50 through 13.02.

title: ftpsrv: FTP server payload for PS5
summary: Opens an FTP server on port 2121 so you can browse and transfer files to the console from any FTP client.
body: ftpsrv from ps5-payload-dev starts an FTP server on port 2121 when loaded as a payload. Connect with any FTP client like FileZilla or WinSCP to browse the console's filesystem and transfer files.
It's part of the ps5-payload-dev SDK. Useful for copying game dumps, installing homebrew manually, or exploring the filesystem. It gives read and write access, so be careful with system directories.
Latest release: ftpsrv v0.21.1 (August 20, 2026).

title: websrv: web server payload for PS5
summary: Opens a web server on port 8080 for serving files from the console or building custom web interfaces.
body: websrv from ps5-payload-dev starts a web server on port 8080 on the PS5. It can serve files from the console's filesystem through a browser, and developers can use it to build custom web interfaces.
Like ftpsrv and elfldr, it's part of the payload SDK ecosystem. Load it as a payload after jailbreaking and access it from any browser on the same network.

title: PS5 Payload SDK: the toolchain behind PS5 homebrew development
summary: The development toolkit for building PS5 payloads. Most homebrew apps are built with this SDK.
body: The PS5 Payload SDK from ps5-payload-dev is the development toolkit that homebrew developers use to build ELF payloads for the PS5. It provides headers, libraries and build scripts for compiling code that runs on a jailbroken console.
It's the foundation of the PS5 homebrew ecosystem. Tools like elfldr, ftpsrv and websrv are all built with it. If you're a developer looking to write PS5 homebrew, this is where you start.
Latest release: PS5 Payload SDK v0.44 (October 10, 2026) — ships LLVM 23 and adds libSceAgc.

title: Snes9x for PS5: standalone SNES emulator
summary: A native PS5 port of Snes9x for playing Super Nintendo games as a standalone homebrew app.
body: Snes9x for PS5 by MisterTemaki is a standalone port of the Snes9x emulator. It runs Super Nintendo games natively on the PS5 without needing RetroArch, so it's simpler to set up if SNES is all you want.
Load your own ROM files and it handles the rest. It's also available as a core in the PS5 RetroArch port if you prefer everything in one launcher. Needs etaHEN and ShadowMountPlus.

title: FinalBurn Neo for PS5: arcade emulation
summary: A native PS5 port of FinalBurn Neo for classic arcade games, CPS1/2/3, Neo Geo and more.
body: FinalBurn Neo for PS5 by MisterTemaki brings arcade emulation to the console as a standalone homebrew app. It covers thousands of arcade boards including CPS1, CPS2, CPS3, Neo Geo, Sega System 16 and many more.
Like the other MisterTemaki ports, it runs natively without RetroArch. Supply your own ROM sets. It's also available as a core in RetroArch if you prefer a unified launcher.

title: Genesis Plus GX for PS5: Mega Drive, Master System and Game Gear
summary: A native PS5 port covering Sega's 8-bit and 16-bit consoles in one standalone emulator.
body: Genesis Plus GX for PS5 by MisterTemaki emulates the Sega Mega Drive (Genesis), Master System and Game Gear as a standalone homebrew app. It's based on the highly accurate Genesis Plus GX core.
It handles the full range of Sega's classic consoles in one app. Supply your own ROM files. Also available as a RetroArch core if you want it alongside other systems.

sources.name: Genesis Plus GX PS5 on GitHub

title: Beetle PCE for PS5: PC Engine and TurboGrafx-16
summary: A native PS5 port of Beetle PCE for NEC's PC Engine, TurboGrafx-16 and SuperGrafx.
body: Beetle PCE for PS5 by MisterTemaki emulates the PC Engine (TurboGrafx-16) and SuperGrafx as a standalone homebrew app. It covers both HuCard and CD-ROM games.
It's based on the Mednafen core, known for high accuracy. Supply your own ROM or disc image files. Available standalone or as a RetroArch core.

title: psp5: PSP emulation on PS5 through PPSSPP
summary: A native PPSSPP port that runs PlayStation Portable games as a standalone PS5 homebrew app.
body: psp5 by tsuramatsu1 is a native port of PPSSPP, the leading PSP emulator. It runs PlayStation Portable games directly on the PS5 with hardware-accelerated graphics through the RADV Vulkan driver.
PPSSPP is one of the most mature emulators around, so compatibility should be strong. Supply your own PSP ISO or CSO files. It needs etaHEN, kstuff and ShadowMountPlus.

title: ps5-linux: the original Linux loader for lower firmware
summary: The first Linux loader for PS5, covering firmware 3.00 to 7.61 on older models. Steam and PC games run through it.
body: ps5-linux is the original Linux loader that first brought desktop Linux to the PS5. It exploits the hypervisor on firmware 3.00 to 7.61 to boot a full Linux distribution with GPU acceleration.

Once Linux is running, you can install Steam, run PC games through Proton, and use the PS5 as a regular Linux desktop. It's the foundation that Playden, PokeMMO and other PC-on-PS5 projects build on. pLinux5-NG is the newer project trying to bring this to higher firmware through Byepervisor Reborn.

title: prospero-win: Wine for PS5 homebrew
summary: A port of Wine that lets PS5 homebrew apps run Windows executables, used by Playden and PokeMMO.
body: prospero-win by mpereiraesaa brings Wine, the Windows compatibility layer, to the PS5 homebrew environment. It translates Windows API calls so that Windows executables can run natively on the console's FreeBSD-based OS.

Playden uses it to run Steam games, and PokeMMO uses it to run the Windows PokeMMO client. It includes DXVK for DirectX 8-11 and Zink for OpenGL translation. It's a developer library rather than an end-user app.

title: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future comes to PS5
summary: A Dreamcast recompilation that brings the 2000 underwater adventure to jailbroken PS5.
body: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future for PS5 by cherryduck is a native recompilation of the Dreamcast classic. It runs natively using the PS5's hardware rather than through emulation.
Like the Xbox 360 recomps, you need your own copy of the game. It's installed through ShadowMountPlus and appears on your home screen as a native title.

title: Wave Race 64 Recompiled for PS5
summary: Nintendo 64's Wave Race 64 recompiled as a native PS5 homebrew title.
body: Wave Race 64 Recompiled by Marice is an N64 recompilation that runs Wave Race 64 natively on PS5. It's part of the growing wave of N64 recomps using the RT64 renderer for modern graphics.
You need your own ROM. Install through ShadowMountPlus. It joins Rush 2 and Super Mario 64 in the N64 recomp lineup for PS5.

title: Ship of Harkinian: Ocarina of Time on PS5
summary: The Ship of Harkinian PC port of Ocarina of Time, built for PS5 with 4K rendering.
body: Ship of Harkinian for PS5 by mshivam019 is a native build of the reverse-engineered Ocarina of Time port. It runs at up to 4K with modern rendering through Vulkan, and uses the DualSense controller natively.
You need your own Ocarina of Time ROM to generate the game data. It's part of a set that includes Majora's Mask (2 Ship 2 Harkinian) and Link's Awakening from the same developer.

sources.name: Ship of Harkinian PS5 on GitHub

title: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian: Majora's Mask on PS5
summary: The reverse-engineered Majora's Mask port, running natively on jailbroken PS5.
body: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian for PS5 by mshivam019 brings Majora's Mask to the console as a native port. Like its Ocarina of Time sibling, it runs through the reverse-engineered PC port with Vulkan rendering.
Supply your own Majora's Mask ROM. It's installed through ShadowMountPlus alongside the other Zelda ports. All three Zelda titles from this developer share the same setup requirements.

title: Link's Awakening port for PS5
summary: A native PS5 port of the reverse-engineered Link's Awakening.
body: Link's Awakening for PS5 by mshivam019 is a native build of the reverse-engineered Game Boy classic. It runs with modern rendering and DualSense support.
Part of the same Zelda port collection as Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask. Supply your own ROM and install through ShadowMountPlus.

title: Super Mario 64 on PS5 via Ghostship
summary: The HarbourMasters Ghostship port of Super Mario 64, built for PS5 with 4K output.
body: Super Mario 64 for PS5 by griches uses the HarbourMasters Ghostship engine to run the game natively at 4K. It first ran on a PS5 on 12 October. You need a US or JP ROM that matches known hashes.
It's one of several Nintendo ports from griches, alongside Wind Waker HD, Wind Waker, Super Mario Sunshine and Dusklight (Twilight Princess). All are installed through ShadowMountPlus.

title: Wind Waker (GameCube) on PS5 via SwitchWaker
summary: The GameCube version of Wind Waker, ported to PS5 through the SwitchWaker project.
body: Wind Waker for PS5 by griches is the GameCube version running through the SwitchWaker project. It's a separate build from the Wind Waker HD recomp, offering the original GameCube experience.
You need your own GameCube dump. It joins a growing collection of Nintendo ports from the same developer, all using Vulkan rendering through RADV on the PS5.

title: Super Mario Sunshine port for PS5
summary: A native PS5 build of the Super Mario Sunshine PC port.
body: Super Mario Sunshine for PS5 by griches is a native build of the reverse-engineered PC port. It runs with Vulkan rendering through RADV and DualSense support.
You need your own GameCube dump to generate the game data. Install through ShadowMountPlus. Part of griches' Nintendo port collection.

sources.name: Super Mario Sunshine PS5 on GitHub

title: Dusklight: Twilight Princess port for PS5
summary: A native PS5 port of Twilight Princess built from a reverse-engineered PC version.
body: Dusklight for PS5 by griches brings Twilight Princess to the console as a native port. It's built from a reverse-engineered version with Vulkan rendering and modern resolution support.
You need your own disc image. Like the other griches ports, install through ShadowMountPlus. It appears on your home screen as a native PS5 title.

title: Doom 3 BFG Edition on PS5
summary: A native PS5 port of RBDoom3BFG, the open-source Doom 3 engine.
body: Doom 3 BFG for PS5 by griches is a port of the RBDoom3BFG engine. It runs Doom 3, its expansion Resurrection of Evil, and The Lost Mission natively on the console with Vulkan rendering.
You need your own copy of Doom 3 BFG Edition for the game data. The engine is open source but the assets aren't. Install through ShadowMountPlus.

title: Quake III Arena on PS5
summary: A native PS5 port of the Quake3e engine for Quake III Arena multiplayer.
body: Quake III for PS5 by griches is a port of the Quake3e engine. It runs Quake III Arena with Vulkan rendering and should handle both singleplayer bots and LAN multiplayer.
You need your own Quake III Arena pak files. The engine is open source. Install through ShadowMountPlus like the other id Software ports.

title: Rush 2 Recompiled for PS5
summary: The N64 racing game Rush 2 recompiled as a native PS5 title using the RT64 renderer.
body: Rush 2 Recompiled for PS5 by Marice is an N64 recompilation of the arcade racing game. It uses the RT64 renderer for modernised graphics while keeping the original gameplay.
You need your own N64 ROM. It's part of the growing wave of N64 static recompilations alongside Wave Race 64 and Super Mario 64. Install through ShadowMountPlus.

title: SuperTuxKart: open-source kart racing on PS5
summary: The free kart racer SuperTuxKart, ported natively to PS5 as a homebrew title.
body: SuperTuxKart for PS5 by Marice is a native port of the open-source kart racing game. Unlike most ports, it doesn't need you to supply any game files since the game itself is free and open source.
It's a full 3D kart racer with single-player and local multiplayer modes. Install through ShadowMountPlus. One of the few ports that's truly free to play without owning another copy.

title: Mario Kart Wii recompiled for PS5
summary: A Wii recompilation of Mario Kart Wii running natively on jailbroken PS5.
body: Mario Kart Wii for PS5 by hollamhide is a Wii recompilation that runs the racing game natively. It's one of the first Wii-era recomps for the console, separate from the Porpoise/Dolphin emulation route.
You need your own copy of Mario Kart Wii. As a recomp it should run more efficiently than emulation since the code is translated to native x86-64. Install through ShadowMountPlus.

sources.name: Mario Kart Wii PS5 on GitHub

title: Xbox 360 recomps reach PS5: Sonic Unleashed, The Simpsons Game and Spider-Man
summary: Static recompilations of Xbox 360 games are now running natively, all built from your own copy of the game.
body: Sonic Unleashed Recompiled for PS5 is a fork of hedge-dev's UnleashedRecomp, the project that brought the Xbox 360 version to PC. It needs your own US or EU Xbox 360 copy plus its title update, and ships no game files.

The Simpsons Game arrives as a Windows 11 builder that turns your own Xbox 360 files into a PS5 title folder. It's based on TheSimpsonsGameRecomp and the ReXGlue recompilation runtime, and it's listed in ProsperoStore. Spider-Man: Edge of Time uses the same ReXGlue approach with a PS5 target. Its developer says a test build first ran at 4K on 12 October and that they've played through the whole game.
FIFA Street (2012) and WWE '13 recomps followed from the RecompStore developer on 16 October. Expect early builds, and check each README for what files you need to supply.

title: Stremio, Emby and Jellyfin clients fill out the media shelf
summary: Two native Stremio ports, Emby5 and Jelly5 join VLC, Moonlight and Steam Remote Play in ProsperoStore.
body: An unofficial Stremio client arrived on 5 October, and StremiBrew, a second native Stremio port, followed on 9 October. Stremio Plus is in ProsperoStore too.
For your own media server there's Emby5, plus Jelly5, which handles both Jellyfin and Emby with hardware-decoded 4K HDR. VLC and Media Player Classic are also on the console now.
For game streaming, ProsperoLight ports Moonlight, Steam Remote Play is available, and PSBox covers Xbox Cloud Gaming.

title: Lapy JB Daemon and LegacyJB give homebrew apps jailbreak access without etaHEN
summary: Two small payloads that answer the jailbreak requests apps would normally send to etaHEN.
body: Some homebrew apps ask etaHEN to lift their privileges when they start. Lapy JB Daemon is a standalone payload that copies that jailbreak-on-demand behaviour, so those apps work without etaHEN. It needs kstuff, and its README lists firmware 3.00 to 12.00. Version 1.2 is dated 7 May in its changelog.

LegacyJB does a similar job. It opens a jailbreak service on port 9028, watches for requests from supported apps, and says it enables Homebrew Store and Itemzflow compatibility. Its firmware target is set when you build it, and it doesn't publish a support list.
Neither project uses GitHub releases, so check their pages for updates.

title: GBA, N64, DS and PS1 emulators are all arriving as native apps
summary: RetroArch, mupen64plus, a melonDS-based DS runtime and a PS1 emulator now run as homebrew titles. Most are early builds.
body: The PS5 RetroArch port runs as a native homebrew title. Its README lists mGBA for Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance, alongside Snes9x, FCEUmm, FinalBurn Neo and Genesis Plus GX. N64 and PS1 cores are on its roadmap, and the repo description now advertises a much bigger core list, so check its page for the current set.

For Nintendo 64 there's a standalone mupen64plus port with a dynarec, DualSense rumble and a cover shelf. SilverBirch is a new Nintendo DS runtime built on the melonDS interpreter. It's at version 0.2.2, and its author says the public build hasn't been tested on a real PS5 yet.

PS1 is covered by PSXS5, based on PCSX-ReARMed, and PSP by psp5, a PPSSPP port. There are standalone Snes9x, Genesis Plus GX, Beetle PCE and FinalBurn Neo ports too. None of them include games or BIOS files, so you supply your own.

title: TabShifter moves apps between the Games and Media tabs
summary: A small payload that re-sorts your home screen and can hide the PSN apps that don't work offline. Its author lists 12.xx to 13.60 as supported.
body: TabShifter is a standalone ELF payload. Run it from Payload Manager or your loader and it can move any app between the Games and Media tabs, then reload the home screen in about a second and a half without a reboot.

It can also hide apps that are useless on an offline console, such as the PlayStation Store, PlayStation Plus and Remote Play. It installs its own home screen tile, which you can uninstall from the console.
It edits the console's app databases to make these changes. The README doesn't include backup steps, so back up first and be ready to undo changes by hand.

title: RecompStore installs recompiled game ports from your own discs
summary: A homebrew store for native ports of recompiled games. It hosts no game files and builds each install from your disc image.
body: RecompStore installs and updates native PS5 ports of recompiled games. You give it your own disc image and it copies the game's files into place, refreshes ShadowMountPlus and launches the port.
Its README says no game files are hosted in the store or in anything it links to. The list of available ports lives on recompstore.com.
It needs kstuff, a payload loader on port 9021 such as etaHEN or elfldr, and ShadowMountPlus 1.7 beta 5 or newer. The installer checks its download against GitHub's SHA-256 before installing.

title: Mihawk is building PS5 Proton and a Windows-style Mihawk OS
summary: A translation layer aimed at 32-bit and 64-bit Windows games on jailbroken PS5. It's closed source and there's no release date.
body: Developer Mihawk, who also ported the RADV Vulkan driver that many PS5 homebrew apps use, is working on PS5 Proton. It's a translation layer for running Windows games on the console, with a Windows 11-style shell called Mihawk OS planned on top.
Windows Central reports Hades has apparently been shown running, but no other games are confirmed. A Linux compatibility layer is also planned.
Unlike most of the scene, Mihawk OS isn't open source. There's no release date yet.

title: pLinux5-NG starts bringing Linux to higher firmware
summary: A port of the ps5-linux loader that uses Byepervisor Reborn. Only 13.20 works for now, and 13.60 isn't confirmed.
body: The original ps5-linux loader covers firmware 3.00 to 7.61 on older models. pLinux5-NG ports it to the Byepervisor Reborn hypervisor escape so it can work on higher firmware.
The project aims for 8.xx to 13.60, but its notice says only 13.20 is supported until offsets for other firmware are found. It describes itself as very much a work in progress.
Linux is what lets Steam and PC games run on the lower-firmware consoles, so this is the one to watch if you're on 13.60.

title: Xbox 360 and original Xbox games now run on jailbroken PS5
summary: PS5X360 ports Xenia Canary, and XPSemu ports xemu. Both are early, and compatibility varies a lot.
body: PS5X360 is an Xbox 360 emulator built on Xenia Canary, with native DualSense input, audio and RADV Vulkan graphics. It's at v0.1.0-preview. Its developer used firmware 13.60 with etaHEN, ShadowMountPlus and kstuff.
For the original Xbox there's XPSemu, a port of xemu. Windows Central reports Halo 2 and Forza running on it, and Gears of War 2 and 3 on PS5X360.
PS5X360's README warns that reaching a menu doesn't mean a game is playable. Games, BIOS files and keys aren't included.

title: PS3 emulation reaches the console: KB-RPCS3 and RPS5S3
summary: An RPCS3 port is out as source code, and the PS5SX2 developer is testing disc-based PS3 builds.
body: KB-RPCS3 is an unofficial RPCS3 port that runs as a native PS5 homebrew title. It's an alpha 0.1.0 source release with no ready-made download, so you have to build it yourself. It was tested on a PS5 Slim on 13.60 with etaHEN, kstuff lite and ShadowMountPlus.
LIMBO and WWE '12 are listed as playable. GTA IV runs at roughly 13 to 27 FPS while driving. The CPU is the bottleneck, and you need your own PS3 firmware file.

Separately, Kotaku reports that Swordpdf, who made PS5SX2, has shown RPS5S3 booting Gran Turismo 5 from a real PS3 disc. It's only in test builds on the PS5SX2 Discord so far, with no public repository.

title: Playden runs your Steam library's Windows games on 13.60
summary: An alpha Steam client that downloads your games and runs each one through Wine for PS5. It signs in to your real Steam account.
body: Playden talks to Steam's servers directly, downloads a game from your library and hands it to a separate PS5 app built for that game. That app runs it through prospero-win, a port of Wine, with DXVK for Direct3D 8 to 11 and Zink for OpenGL.
It's built for jailbroken 13.60 consoles with kstuff lite, ShadowMountPlus 1.7-beta5fix1 and elfldr. You also need a computer with Python 3 on the same network.
It's alpha software that reads and writes Steam Cloud saves, so a bug could overwrite a good save. Your Steam login token is stored on the console unencrypted.

title: PSBox brings Xbox Cloud Gaming to jailbroken PS5
summary: A homebrew client for Microsoft's cloud gaming service, running on the console.
body: PSBox Cloud Gaming, by RafaelNGP, adds Xbox Cloud Gaming as a way to play on a jailbroken PS5. It's not officially supported by Microsoft or Sony.
It's one of the few ways to play newer games on a console that has to stay offline from PSN to keep its jailbreak.

title: Mario 64, Wind Waker HD and Twilight Princess ports land on PS5
summary: A run of native ports built on the PS5 Vulkan stack. Each one needs your own copy of the game.
body: Developer griches has put out a string of PS5 builds of existing PC ports. Super Mario 64 uses HarbourMasters' Ghostship and first ran on a PS5 at 4K on 12 October. There's Wind Waker HD from the ZeldaWWHDRecomp project, the GameCube Wind Waker through SwitchWaker, Super Mario Sunshine, and Dusklight for Twilight Princess.
None of them include game data. Super Mario 64 checks your US or JP ROM against known hashes, and the others are built from your own dump or disc image.
Rush 2 Recompiled has also arrived as a native PS5 title using RT64. RecompStore is aiming to make installing ports like these a one-step job.

title: Pokémon on PS5: a PokeMMO port, plus GBA and DS emulators
summary: PokeMMO's Windows client now runs locally through Wine. The handheld Pokémon games work through the new emulators.
body: ps5-pokemmo runs the official Windows PokeMMO client on a jailbroken PS5 through Wine, with no streaming. You download the client separately and need your own Pokémon Black or White ROM, with FireRed, Emerald, Platinum and HeartGold or SoulSilver optional.
It's experimental. Startup and 1080p display are tested, but login and full gameplay haven't been fully verified yet.
For the original handheld games, mGBA in the PS5 RetroArch port covers Game Boy to Game Boy Advance, and SilverBirch is an early Nintendo DS option.

title: Y2JB Autoloader 1.0 uses Relapse for firmware 8.00 to 13.60
summary: The YouTube-based autoloader now picks Relapse as its kernel exploit and launches Payload Manager by default.
body: itsPLK's Y2JB Autoloader is a fork of Y2JB that loads a kernel exploit and then your payloads automatically. Version 1.0.0 made Relapse the preferred exploit on 8.00 to 13.60, except 9.05 and 11.40, as long as the console has a network connection. It falls back to Lapse on 10.01 and below.
Without an autoload list, it opens Payload Manager, a web dashboard for importing payloads and choosing what loads at startup. With an autoload.txt, it loads your list in order instead.
1.0.1 and 1.0.2 followed on 13 and 14 October with fixes, including firmware 7.xx support for Relapse.

title: ShadowPKG and PS5 Upload make managing packages from your PC easier
summary: A self-hosted web package manager is new, and PS5 Upload's 5.40 notes say it's tested on 13.60.
body: ShadowPKG is a self-hosted web app that reads the .pkg files in folders you choose, lets you browse and search them, and sends them to a console over your network. It runs on Node or Docker and works from a phone browser. It doesn't supply any games.

PS5 Upload covers more ground: sending games and homebrew, mounting images, save backups and launching apps from a computer, phone or browser. Its 5.40.0 notes say it was tested on 13.60 on a standard PS5 and a PS5 Pro.
PS5 Upload also notes that fake-package installs only work up to firmware 11.60.

title: PS5CEMU-HAR runs Wii U and 3DS games, with Breath of the Wild at 4K
summary: One app bundles Cemu for Wii U and Azahar for 3DS, both on the PS5 port of the RADV Vulkan driver.
body: TweakTown reports Breath of the Wild running at native 4K and 30 FPS. The author says most Wii U games tried are playable, with video, controls, sound and saves working.
3DS support through Azahar arrived in version 2.0.0 and has had little testing on real hardware. It renders at up to 10x internal resolution.

It needs etaHEN, and the app has to be on etaHEN's jailbreak list for JIT. Without it, Wii U games fall back to a much slower interpreter. You need your own dumps, plus keys from your own console for encrypted ones.

title: Porpoise brings Dolphin to PS5 for GameCube and Wii
summary: A native Dolphin-based emulator with a cover-flow library and memory card manager. Wii support is experimental.
body: Porpoise runs Dolphin's libretro core as a native PS5 app, using Dolphin's x86-64 JIT and Vulkan through RADV. It has its own TV launcher with box art, a memory card manager and per-game settings.
It reads .iso, .rvz, .wbfs and other common formats from your own backups. Wii support is experimental, and Wii Remote emulation on the DualSense is in beta.
It needs etaHEN and kstuff, plus ShadowMountPlus or another way to register homebrew. From version 1.1 it can update itself from its settings menu.

title: Omega offers an open-source replacement home screen
summary: A dashboard that can take over as your home screen, with a homebrew store, music playback and system tools.
body: Omega is an open-source dashboard for jailbroken PS5s that asks on first launch whether you want it to be your home screen. It combines installed games and homebrew on one row and adds a store of open-source homebrew.
It also has music that keeps playing during games, a phone remote on port 9095, system tools for temperatures, fans and storage, and community features like chat.
It needs a homebrew enabler such as etaHEN or OnionHEN. The README doesn't list supported firmware versions, so check before relying on it on 13.60.

title: ProsperoStore puts the homebrew.page catalog on the console
summary: A native store for browsing, installing and updating community homebrew with the controller.
body: ProsperoStore is a native app for the homebrew.page catalog, with Apps, Games and Tools sections and a list of new and updated entries. It's an alpha, version 01.000.000.
It needs ShadowMountPlus, with 1.7beta4 recommended, and an ELF loader on port 9021. You copy its folder into /data/homebrew and it appears on the home screen.
Its author has tested installs on firmware 6.02 and 12.70. Anything else, 13.60 included, is marked experimental.

title: PS5SX2 1.00 launches, porting PCSX2 to PS5
summary: A native PS2 emulator with up to 6x internal resolution, settings from your phone and widescreen patches.
body: Developer Sword released PS5SX2, a port of PCSX2 that runs entirely on the PS5 and PS5 Pro. It scales internal resolution from 1x to 6x with 4K output, and has FSR and a CRT filter.
You change settings from a web page on your phone by scanning a QR code. It also supports widescreen and 60 FPS patches, save states, texture replacements and a cover-flow library.
At launch it had only been tested on a PS5 Pro on firmware 11.40. It needs kstuff, ShadowMountPlus and its own helper payload, plus your own BIOS and game files.

Latest updates bring up to 6x native resolution rendering, FSR upscaling, a 3D cover-flow shelf for browsing your PS2 library, widescreen and 60fps patches, and experimental online play — SOCOM II lobbies have been tested. Disc support and PS5 standard (non-Pro) compatibility have been added. The project has 79 commits.

title: PSN now requires firmware 14.10
summary: Consoles still on 14.00 or older can no longer sign in to PlayStation Network, so staying exploitable now means staying offline.
body: Reports from Notebookcheck and GBAtemp say Sony has made 14.10 the minimum firmware for signing in to PSN. Consoles left on 14.00 are locked out, and anything older is in the same position.

This doesn't change what the exploits can do. Relapse still needs 13.60 or lower. What changes is the trade-off: a jailbreakable console is now an offline console, which affects online multiplayer, the PlayStation Store and licence checks for some digital games.
Neither report describes a workaround. Spoofing the firmware version on a jailbroken console was raised in the GBAtemp thread as likely to risk a ban.

title: Byepervisor Reborn brings a hypervisor bypass to 13.20 and 13.60
summary: A developer-focused hypervisor exploit that opens the kernel for dumping and patching. It isn't a jailbreak you can run on its own.
body: Byepervisor Reborn abuses the way the PS5 wakes from rest mode to reach the hypervisor's memory. From there, developers can switch off the execute-only protection on kernel memory, which means the kernel can be dumped and patched.
Firmware 13.20 and 13.60 are supported. A 13.00 configuration is included but untested. The vulnerability may reach back further, but the release doesn't cover that range.

It ships without the payloads a player-ready jailbreak needs, and it doesn't bring Linux to these firmwares by itself. The developers describe it as a tool for other developers. There's no build for 14.00, and Notebookcheck reports that 14.00 ended its run.

title: PS5SX2 can now play original PS2 discs
summary: The PCSX2-based emulator reads PS2 DVDs from the console's own drive, with up to 6x internal resolution and 4K output.
body: PS5SX2, a PCSX2 port by homebrew developer Sword, added support for reading PS2 discs from the PS5's drive. The first time a disc goes in, it's copied to a file, and later launches skip the copy.
Supported games can run at up to 6x internal resolution with 4K output, plus widescreen and frame-rate patches.

The drive only reads DVDs, so PS2 games released on CD won't work. External USB drives are supported but experimental. Asked about PS3 discs, Sword replied that it will happen, with no timeline given.

title: GTA VI will reportedly need firmware 14.10
summary: A datamine says the launch build won't boot below 14.10, which puts it out of reach of 13.60 jailbroken consoles.
body: The datamining account PlayStation Game Size reports that GTA VI's launch build needs firmware 14.10 or newer.
Relapse tops out at 13.60, so a jailbroken console won't boot the game at launch. Updating to 14.10 to play it removes access to the jailbreak.
Neither Rockstar nor Sony has confirmed the requirement.

title: Firmware 14.10 is out with unlisted security fixes
summary: Sony's October update follows 14.00 by two weeks. There's no public exploit for either version.
body: Sony released system software 14.10 on 1 October. The patch notes only mention security fixes and stability improvements.
It lands two weeks after 14.00, which arrived on 16 September and had already closed the window for Relapse and Byepervisor Reborn.
If your console is on 13.60 or lower and you want to keep it exploitable, leave automatic system updates off.

title: Relapse jailbreak lands for firmware 7.00 to 13.60
summary: A browser-based WebKit and kernel chain for PS5 and PS5 Pro. It loads the usual payloads and has to be rerun after every reboot.
body: Developer Nathan Fargo released Relapse, an exploit chain that starts in the console's built-in browser and ends with kernel access. It works on the original PS5 and the PS5 Pro, disc and digital, from 7.00 up to 13.60.
Once it runs, an ELF loader is available, so the usual homebrew payloads load. The previous public kernel jailbreak stopped at 12.70.

It's tethered, so a full restart returns the console to stock. There's no hypervisor exploit in the chain, so Linux isn't possible on 13.60 through Relapse. The source is on GitHub under the MIT licence.

title: ProsperoEden puts a Switch emulator on jailbroken PS5
summary: A native PS5 port of the Eden emulator, built with the payload SDK. It's an early alpha.
body: ProsperoEden is an unofficial port of Eden, a Yuzu fork, that runs as native PS5 homebrew with no Linux layer in between.
The README calls it an early alpha. Video, audio, DualSense input and saves are confirmed working.
The original repository has been archived as ProsperoEden-Legacy, and development moved to a new repository on 30 September. It builds on recent PS5 Vulkan and Mesa graphics work from the same scene.

title: Sony tells a US court that digital games are licensed, not owned
summary: Sony's filing in a California class action adds fuel to the backup and preservation argument around PS5 homebrew.
body: In a class action in the Northern District of California, Sony argued that reasonable buyers wouldn't believe they were getting ownership of digital games, pointing to licence terms that say the software is licensed rather than sold.
Sony's main request is to move the dispute into private arbitration. The judge hadn't ruled on that at the time of reporting.
The filing landed in the same stretch as Sony's plan to stop shipping new games on disc, and both get cited in the scene as reasons to keep backups of games you own.

title: Sony's disc exit is pushing more players to look at jailbreaking
summary: New PlayStation games stop shipping on disc from January 2028, and searches for PS5 jailbreak terms went up after the news.
body: Sony confirmed that from January 2028, new titles won't ship on disc. Polygon reported that searches for PS5 jailbreak and piracy terms rose after the announcement.
Within the homebrew scene, the case is mostly about preservation: keeping working backups of games you already own once physical copies are gone.

title: ProsperoStore catalogue: every emulator available for PS5
summary: The full list of emulators in the ProsperoStore catalogue, from PS1 to Switch. All run as native homebrew apps.
body: The ProsperoStore catalogue now includes emulators covering nearly every classic console. PS2 through PS5SX2, PS3 through KB-RPCS3, PSP through psp5, PS1 through PSXS5 and SwanStation. For Nintendo there's ProsperoEden for Switch, PS5CEMU-HAR for Wii U and 3DS, Porpoise for GameCube and Wii, mupen64plus and RetroArch for N64, SilverBirch for DS, and standalone SNES, GBA and Game Boy emulators through RetroArch.

Xbox consoles are covered by PS5X360 for 360 and XPSemu for the original Xbox. Arcade fans have FinalBurn Neo and MAME through RetroArch. For Sega there's Genesis Plus GX and Beetle PCE for PC Engine. The catalogue auto-syncs to this site, so new emulators appear within an hour of being added.
All emulators need your own game files and typically require etaHEN, kstuff and ShadowMountPlus. Check each app's page for specific firmware compatibility.

title: ProsperoStore catalogue: media players, streaming clients and game streaming
summary: Everything in the catalogue for watching, listening and streaming on a jailbroken PS5.
body: The media section of ProsperoStore has grown significantly. For local media there's VLC and Media Player Classic. For streaming services there are two Stremio ports (the original and StremiBrew), plus Stremio Plus. Media server clients include Emby5, Jelly5 (Jellyfin and Emby), and several IPTV apps.

Game streaming is covered by ProsperoLight (Moonlight for remote play from a PC), Steam Remote Play, and PSBox for Xbox Cloud Gaming. There are also YouTube, Twitch and Spotify alternatives in the catalogue.
Most media apps are simpler to set up than emulators and don't need kstuff. Check each app's README for network requirements, since a jailbroken console typically stays off PSN.

title: ProsperoStore catalogue: utilities, file managers and system tools
summary: The full range of tools in the catalogue for managing a jailbroken PS5, from file transfer to save management.
body: Beyond the headline tools, the ProsperoStore catalogue includes dozens of utilities. File management is covered by ftpsrv, websrv, PS5 Upload and PS5-Suite. Save management has MacheteSVG. Game management includes Itemzflow, PS5 Game Compressor and ShadowPKG for PKG files.

System tools include TabShifter for reorganising the home screen, Omega Dashboard as a replacement shell, and Payload Manager for managing your exploit payloads. Developer tools include the PS5 Payload SDK, Remote Lua Loader and various debug utilities.
New tools are added to the catalogue regularly. This site syncs the full catalogue every hour, so anything added to ProsperoStore shows up here automatically.

title: ProsperoStore catalogue: every recomp, port and game on PS5
summary: Native game ports and recompilations available through the catalogue, from N64 to Xbox 360.
body: The ports section includes Xbox 360 recomps (Sonic Unleashed, The Simpsons Game, Spider-Man: Edge of Time, FIFA Street, WWE '13), N64 recomps (Wave Race 64, Rush 2, Super Mario 64), Wii recomps (Mario Kart Wii), and Dreamcast recomps (Ecco the Dolphin).

PC port conversions include the Zelda trilogy (Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask, Link's Awakening), Wind Waker HD, Super Mario Sunshine, Twilight Princess, Doom 3 BFG and Quake III. SuperTuxKart is the one free game that doesn't need you to supply files. All other ports need your own copy of the original game.
RecompStore makes installing many of these a one-step process from your disc image. New ports appear in the catalogue regularly as the recompilation scene keeps growing.
